{{Quote|I'm a city girl, but there's something about this place that rubs me wrong.|Vette|<ref name="Codex" />}}
'''Kaas City''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]], the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]], established in a jungle environment on the Sith capital world of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. After the destruction of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|previous Sith Empire]] in the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], the remnants of the Sith eventually settled on the remote planet of Dromund Kaas. This led to Kaas City's rise from a small settlement into a massive metropolitan area that served as the home of many important [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], most notably the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] and the members of his [[Dark Council]].

==History==
[[File:KaasCity.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Kaas City from a distance.]]

At the end of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] emerged triumphant against the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Old Sith Empire]]. Unwilling to allow the Sith any chance of threatening the peace of the Republic ever again, the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] dispatched a combined force of Jedi and Republic troops to annihilate the remnants of the Sith on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and other Sith worlds. This led to the brutal genocide of millions of Sith and Imperial citizens across the old Empire. While this action effectively broke the power of the Sith for centuries to come, what remained of the Sith were able to flee deep into hiding. In search of a new homeworld, the Sith eventually rediscovered [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], a forgotten colonial world of the Sith Empire. Deep within a jungle, the last of the Sith established a small settlement that gradually grew into the vast urban center known as Kaas City.

With Dromund Kaas virtually isolated from the rest of the known [[Galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]], the Sith were able to rebuild their strength in Kaas City without fear of being discovered by the Republic or the Jedi. The Emperor worked tirelessly over the span of many centuries, plotting to exact vengeance on the Sith's ancient enemies by slowly and steadily restoring the Sith Empire back to its former glory. Upon the long anticipated completion of the Emperor's vast [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|armies]] and [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|naval forces]], the Sith Empire declared war on the Galactic Republic, thus launching the [[Great Galactic War]]. In the aftermath of the Republic's defeat, Kaas City became the center of an even larger empire that ruled half of the Galaxy, while the other half remained under the Republic's control during the era of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Eventually the Sith Empire would fall after the [[Galactic War]] and Dromund Kaas would be forgotten by the galaxy at large.

By [[44 ABY]], long after the Sith Empire vanished from the galaxy, Kaas City continued to exist, although as abandoned ruins.

==Layout==
At the time of the Cold War, Kaas City was divided into six districts known as hubs. The [[Ministry of Logistics|Ministry of Travel]]'s office was located in [[Hub 3]].<ref name="Kiosk">The six hubs and the [[Ministry of Logistics|Ministry of Travel]] are only mentioned kiosk maps of Kaas City featured in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.</ref> Among the city's most notable structures was the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]], within which were the headquarters for the Imperial [[Spheres of Influence]], with the exception of the [[Sphere of Mysteries|Sphere Of Mysteries]], which was assumed by the public to share a headquarters with the [[Sphere of Ancient Knowledge]], though in reality did not exist at all. In addition to its purpose as a visible symbol of the Sith Empire's restoration to glory, the citadel was also the headquarters of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] and his [[Dark Council]].<ref name="TOR" />
